summary: Surveyed all 91 listed Lean files under Complexitylib/DescriptiveComplexity (sizes 699 to 15391 bytes; all in the main source tree, no scripts, tests, build output, or vendored data). A line-start declaration scan (theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque, with attribute and modifier prefixes) found 730 declarations in total; 89 files carry at least one declaration. The two zero-declaration files, FirstOrder.lean and SecondOrder.lean, were read completely: each is a module-system import aggregator with a module docstring and is retained under FILTER-007 because no auxiliary navigation channel is verified. Every file stays searchable; no exclusions.
